description: Defines the ScanResultAdapter class, a custom adapter for displaying Bluetooth scan results in an Android app, including methods for managing scan result data and formatting time since last seen.

classes.name: ScanResultAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to display Bluetooth scan results, manage list data, and format time since last seen.

methods.name: ScanResultAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context, inflater, and scan result list.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of scan results.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the scan result at a given position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a unique ID for the item based on device address hash code.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view to display a scan result, populating device name, address, and last seen time.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of a device in the list by address.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new scan result or updates existing one based on device address.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the list of scan results.

methods.name: getTimeSinceString
methods.description: Formats a human-readable string indicating how long ago a device was last seen, based on nanoseconds.
